mainEntity.name: Is strength training beneficial for weight loss?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, strength training is highly beneficial for weight loss. While cardiovascular exercise burns more calories during a workout, strength training builds muscle mass, which increases your resting metabolism. This means your body burns more calories even when you're not exercising. Additionally, it helps preserve muscle during a caloric deficit, ensuring that weight lost is primarily fat. At Cave Training, we can incorporate strength training into a broader fitness plan to support your weight loss and body composition goals.
acceptedAnswer.description: Strength training aids weight loss by building muscle, which increases resting metabolism and helps burn more calories throughout the day, preserving muscle mass during calorie deficits.
